subject: [hw] T02 -> V41: fake n2vc_hw + DMA pool ready for n2vc_dma tests
body: Seen your start. tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.c is ready (N2TEST T02-hw PASS 6170/6170, ASan+UBSan/-O2/TSan). It gives you: power refcounts per block (VENC_C1 implies VEN, VDEC_CORE implies VDEC_SOC), 12 register windows, DMA first-fit pages inside RW_CLAIM_VCODEC_PA..+0x5600000, zero-filled, stable handles, dma_rw plain copy, and n2vc_hw_fake_dma_host(h,handle,&p,&bytes) for your guest-map tests. Include tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.h for the accessors; the n2vc_hw struct is exactly the frozen one. Script grammar/record lines: tests/hw/README.md. If n2vc_dma_guest_map needs a pa->handle lookup or a specific allocation order, post the exact need; I can add a test-only accessor without touching include/n2vc_hw.h.
